title: Sherlog Lint-Plan Input
description: A structured plan submitted by an AI agent for pre-flight validation before code changes begin.

feature.description: Human-readable label for the feature or task being planned.

provenance.description: Provenance-typed declaration. Every field carries a state of 'verified', 'assumed', or 'unknown'. Required by the unverified_declaration rule in lint-plan.js. Absent provenance → verdict 'rejected'.

steps.description: Ordered list of intended implementation steps.

action.description: Short verb-phrase describing what this step does (e.g. 'implement protocol handler', 'add unit tests', 'update docs').

files.description: Repo-relative file paths that this step will create or modify.

rationale.description: Optional explanation of why this step is needed.

type.description: Classification of this step. Used for gap-coverage checks.

provenanceField.description: A provenance-typed declaration field. state is a closed enum: 'verified', 'assumed', or 'unknown'. An absent field is treated as 'unknown', never 'verified'. 'verified' without a non-empty 'source' is a schema error.

value.description: The declared value. Type varies by field (string, array, object).

state.description: verified = Sherlog measured it; assumed = agent stated it, Sherlog couldn't verify; unknown = agent couldn't fill it.

source.description: How the value was checked. Required and non-empty when state is 'verified'.
